verificationGate: satisfied under the human-approved story-specific exception; independent review completed, six correction groups applied, and all post-review checks satisfied

findings.summary: Shared CI enforcement can be removed without the shared-job tests failing.
findings.evidence: The verification reviewer removed the guard through an in-memory workflow mutation and all 20 CompositeHarness tests still passed. Add committed sample drift at the real job boundary and assert ownership failure before prepare/build/hooks.

findings.summary: Release adapter tests bypass actual delivered-sha and expected-source environment mappings.
findings.evidence: The verification reviewer removed both composite mappings and all 12 adapter tests still passed because they injected RELEASE_* variables directly. Evaluate metadata defaults/mappings and execute paired sample and ancestor cases.
The intent contract explicitly requires pinned Git objects and dirty/staged/sparse independence. Comparing committed state is the requested behavior, and checkout precedes guard in the deployed job.

findings.summary: Hosted sample coverage has one owned file rather than all nine perimeter kinds.
findings.evidence: The story explicitly defines a one-whole-entry sample perimeter and assigns nine-kind coverage to disposable real repositories. Both surfaces are exercised as requested.

findings.summary: Fixture adapters do not prove an adopted module's live delivered branch.
findings.evidence: The dispatched story excludes module onboarding and production release. Actual composites plus hosted Builds/sample verification satisfy its stated integration surface; adoption is not claimed.

findings.summary: Aggregate diff includes unrelated package pins and superproject gitlinks.
findings.evidence: The two package changes are already present in integration revision 05a75b626fb73c6e386d16c41e885f193d3cff16 and unchanged by source 0f97426edb6f88ee6e534d95ca9029f7e0b20311. A concurrent superproject /pushall advanced the other gitlinks; this run did not author them.

findings.summary: The review diff alone cannot establish current remote delivery or final completion.
findings.evidence: Pushed implementation/evidence are verified by Git remote reads and the completed exact-source GitHub run. The review handoff correctly does not claim completion; finalization follows triage and validation.

findings.summary: Deepening through the raw remote loses the blob filter.
findings.evidence: A filtering-enabled local Git reproduction fetched the unrelated historical blob with unfiltered --unshallow; adding --filter=blob:none kept that blob absent. Retain filtering on deepening.

findings.summary: Comparison.expected exposes a snapshot after its temporary repository has been removed.
findings.evidence: Reading an uncached expected blob after compare_repository returned raised ExpectedStateError. No production caller uses this field; delete the unused field/argument and retain durable actual/workspace snapshots plus materialized diagnostics.

findings.summary: Multiple partial entries at one path can have indistinguishable explanations.
findings.evidence: Two legal absent-line patterns produced the same path/kind/partial diagnostic. The fixed ownership error and violated path remain correct; entry disambiguation would add matching/association logic for an uncommon diagnostic case, so the cosmetic extension is rejected.

findings.summary: Whole-file symlink drift omits the two target strings.
findings.evidence: A real Git symlink mismatch reports the owned path and content reason correctly. The module perimeter uses ordinary managed configuration/workflow files; extra symlink-specific report branches are not justified for this rare cosmetic case.

findings.summary: Individual Git subprocesses do not have a separate deadline.
findings.evidence: Git.run does not set a subprocess timeout; hosted CI/release jobs already have 30/40-minute bounds and fail closed. An additional timeout policy and exception branches for the rare transport stall would add complexity beyond a direct correction.

findings.summary: Configuration diagnostics expose a random temporary materialization path.
findings.evidence: A matching unsupported-schema fixture emitted /tmp/hexalith-guard-config-<random>/hexalith-ci.json. Preserve loader wording while reporting the committed logical path and verify repeated failures are identical.

findings.summary: Repository-local URL/header config can steer production anonymous acquisition.
findings.evidence: The demonstrated settings remain active only in an existing repository. Production accepted-state and Builds-tag acquisition use fresh private repositories with fixed remotes and stripped global/environment configuration. Actions checkout supplies an unfiltered module tree with persist-credentials=false; no actual-workspace lazy-fetch path carrying those settings is used by these callers.

findings.summary: Existing transports do not exercise genuine filtered clone/lazy blob retrieval.
findings.evidence: LocalTransport omits filtering and the adapter's file transport has filtering disabled by default. Add a filtering-enabled executed transport regression covering owned lazy reads, deepening and continued absence of unrelated historical blobs; this accompanies B1.

findings.summary: Pinned delivered-tip behavior during branch advancement lacks a controlled race regression.
findings.evidence: The code freezes tip before deepening and enumerates its ancestors, but existing tests never advance the branch between those operations. Add a direct branch-advance control asserting comparison remains tied to the original tip.

findings.summary: Early invalid source selection should still recover ordinary-module dispatch security settings.
findings.evidence: The spec prohibits parsing ordinary-module config before a completed create comparison, and prohibits expected-state acquisition in complete mode. Ambiguous/invalid draft selection establishes neither mode safely, so fail-closed output suppression is intentional. Builds root alone has no comparison prerequisite and retains its prior recovery.

patchActions.V1: Added committed sample drift through the actual shared workflow and assertions that prepare/build/hooks do not run.
patchActions.V2: The release adapter now evaluates real composite defaults/environment mappings and executes paired-sample and exact-ancestor cases.
patchActions.B2: Deleted the unused expected snapshot field and constructor argument.
patchActions.B6: Loader diagnostics now name .github/hexalith-ci.json; repeated malformed/unknown-schema runs assert stable wording.
patchActions.B8: Added a filtering-enabled Git transport regression proving lazy owned reads and absence of unrelated historical blobs.
patchActions.B9: Added a controlled delivered-branch advance during deepening, testing both the pinned ancestor and rejection of the newly advanced commit.

review.followupRisk: The corrected filtered-history acquisition and release input-mapping paths have behavioral verification but have not had a separate subsequent independent review. Hosted Builds/sample validation does not exercise an adopted module's live delivered branch.
